text: alright man look here so i got my doors solid [Image #15] and then here is the body with the doors off [Image #16] [Image #17] so u can see its almost closed in entirely. really the back side would be covered by a seat but the front where like a pedal/dash would be. but i dont need that much of a interior i just need it to not look like the model is floating on nothing from thru the window haha
resolution: User shared progress — doors now solid with proper glass frames, cab body nearly fully enclosed via solidify — and stated the real goal: not a full interior, just stop the cab reading as 'floating on nothing' when viewed through the windshield. Advised — no code changed. Confirmed the work looks correct and that the single remaining fix is a cab FLOOR: in vert mode select the four bottom-interior corners, Create face, Flip so the normal points up; that kills the see-through-to-void look. Added the alternative: if a bottom face already exists (the underbody slab) facing down, skip Create and just Flip/solidify it so it reads from inside. Reaffirmed the back recess can stay hollow (seat occludes it) and the front-low area is where a dash/pedals would sit, so no further interior is needed.
